{{Top|leg}}
{{Conjecture|legends}}
An '''intelligence agent''' who worked for the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] filed a report on the [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] group known as the [[Aurodium Sword/Legends|Aurodium Sword]]. The agent included an image of the group, which depicted the rogue [[Advanced Recon Commando/Legends|ARC trooper]] known as [[Muzzle/Legends|Muzzle]], the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Snoova]], and [[Unidentified Wookiee mercenary|another Wookiee]] [[Unidentified Aurodium Sword skirmish|defending]] a [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] [[Unidentified Sullustan executive|business executive]] from an [[Assassin/Legends|assassination]] attempt. The report and image made their way to [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Maximillian Seerdon]] of the [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|Imperial Security Bureau]], who included both the report and image in a dossier on underworld figures he compiled in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]]. The report kept the agent's identity classified.<ref name="UAGoSaV">{{InsiderCite|89|Underworld: A Galaxy of Scum and Villainy}}</ref>
